title: The ruled sheet, ignored
logline: A sheet with the blue-pencil tiers ruled and the drawing of the flats laid across all three at once, the tide line cutting through the gutters like they aren't there. The second page to do it; the first to do it on purpose.

panels.composition: A sheet of paper with faint blue-pencil tier lines ruled across it and a drawing of mudflats laid over all three tiers at once, the tide line running straight through the ruled gutters.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a sheet with faint blue pencil tier lines ruled across it and a drawing of tidal mudflats laid across all three tiers at once with the tide line running straight through the ruled gutters, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
